title: parse.rs build_part: 'let _ = nested' for message/rfc822 silently drops children without explanation
description: In parse.rs line 156, PartType::Message(nested) sets let _ = nested and returns an empty children vec. The comment says 'actual decode happens in decode_body_value' but does not explain that nested message/rfc822 parts are intentionally treated as leaves with their byte range intact (the raw bytes are still accessible via body_range). A reader might think nested message parsing is simply broken or forgotten. The comment should explain the design intent: the outer part's body_range covers the nested message bytes, and the caller can call parse() on those bytes if needed.
